subject: Aligning Q1 partner events calendar and MDF split
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@brightlane.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partnerships@vertexcloud.com, kyle.myers@eventcorp.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Q1 webinar + regional booth — initial availability

Hi Lauren,

Hope you're well — Emma from BrightLane. We ran the numbers for co-hosted events next quarter and we'd love to propose a two-track approach: a joint thought-leadership webinar in late January followed by a shared booth at the West Coast Data Summit in March.

High-level asks from our side:
- 45-minute webinar (one speaker each, 15min demo slot + 15min live Q&A)
- Shared booth 10x20 at WCDS (split table, branded backdrop)
- MDF contribution: BrightLane proposes 40/30/30 (BL / Redwood / Venue ops) for the booth line items and 50/50 for the webinar promotion spend.

Do you have budget/account owners for MDF on Redwood's side? Also curious about Redwood's availability for a planning call this week — we can work around PST mornings.

Attaching a rough calendar and our suggested MDF terms.

Best,
Emma
Emma Zhao
Head of Partnerships, BrightLane
attachments: RLQ1_Partner_Calendar_v1.xlsx, CoMarketing_MDF_Terms_v3.pdf

Emma — thanks for this and the clear proposal. We're excited; both ideas align with our Q1 GTM priorities. Quick answers up front:

- MDF ownership: we have a small co-op pool we can allocate, and Sergio can own the contract/terms on the sales side.
- Webinar: late Jan window works for us (Jan 25–28). We'll confirm speakers after the planning call.
- Booth: WCDS in March — Mar 10–12 — thumbs up in principle. We need to confirm exact booth placement and lead capture plan.

Proposed next step: 30-min planning sync to lock calendar and agree on MDF percentages + deliverables. Sergio / Tessa / Marissa are cc'd for ops + field logistics. Sergio — can you lead the MDF & commercial side? Tessa/Marissa — please review the attached calendar and booth layout when you have a minute.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop

Lauren / Emma — happy to own MDF coordination. A few commercial notes from legal/finance intake:

- The 40/30/30 split for booth ops is acceptable as a starting point; Redwood will want a simple SOW naming specific line items (freight, shipping, drayage, electrical, lead-capture hardware).
- Webinar promotion spend: 50/50 is fine; we'll need clear KPIs (registrations, attendance, SQLs) and an attribution window (30 days post-webinar).
- Contract cadence: we usually handle co-op via a short MSA addendum + a purchase order for Redwood's share. I can draft initial language and circulate for signature.

Can we meet Friday (Oct 9) at 11:00 AM PST? I can share a first pass of the MDF SOW during the call.

Thanks — Sergio

Thanks Sergio — 11:00 AM PST Fri works. We'll be prepared to walk through:
- Draft SOW line items (Emma/BL ops)
- Promotion plan and co-branded assets (marketing ops)
- Booth logistics and lead-capture specs (EventCorp — Kyle looped)

A couple of clarifying points for the call so we converge faster:
1) Can Redwood commit a named speaker for the webinar (product or customer)? If not, we can provide a case study slot.
2) For MDF invoicing: do you prefer milestone-based (half on booking, half post-event) or net-30 post-invoice?

Attaching a 1-page overview of our proposed promotion channels.

—Emma

Emma / team — quick recap after today's call and action items: great discussion, aligned on scope. Short summary for the thread so we have a single source of truth.

Decisions made:
- Webinar: scheduled for Jan 27, 2027 at 10:00 AM PST. Redwood speaker: Product PM (Ana Reyes) confirmed; BrightLane to provide a customer case study (live). Promotion split 50/50; KPI targets: 1,200 registrations, 450 attendees, 30 SQLs.
- Booth: WCDS Mar 10–12, 2027. Booth size confirmed 10x20. MDF split for booth costs set to 40/30/30 (BrightLane / Redwood / Venue ops). Redwood to cover lead-capture tablet rental and bridge network costs (line item in draft SOW).
- Contract/MDF: Sergio to circulate the SOW & 1-page co-marketing addendum by EOD Tue (Nov 16). Payment terms: milestone-based (50% on booking, 50% 14 days post-event).

Action owners:
- Sergio: draft SOW + PO template (due Nov 16)
- Marissa: booth logistics + vendor contact (EventCorp) — please confirm lead-capture hardware SKU and cost by Nov 20
- Tessa: co-branded creative brief + social calendar (due Nov 22)
- Emma / BrightLane: confirm customer case study speaker and provide slides by Jan 15

Attachments from today's call: Booth_Layout_SKU123.png, CoMarketing_MDF_Terms_v3.pdf (updated). Links: shared calendar invite + HubSpot playbook (see related_links).

If anyone sees discrepancies, flag here — otherwise we'll proceed to signoff.

Thanks all — LA
